aism_behavior: differs: AISM's check-report-shards.sh reads MAX_LINES from an env var with no type validation either, but this fixture is about rk's own .rk/config.json path specifically, which has no AISM counterpart.
notes: rk-xbm (M1 review B1): reproduces the finding's other named consequence -- shardsMaxLines: 'garbage' in .rk/config.json. Before this bead, src/gates/shards.ts:152's `lineCount > config.shardsMaxLines` coerced the string to NaN, and any comparison against NaN is false -- a false-green on the per-shard line-cap check regardless of how long a shard actually was. `validateConfigOverrides` (src/gates/config.ts) now rejects this at the .rk/config.json-loading edge: `shardsMaxLines` falls back to the numeric default (280) and one loud ERROR is produced; src/gates/shards.ts's own Check 7 additionally hardens itself directly (defense in depth) so the line-cap check keeps working even for a caller that bypasses loadGateConfig. Wired into the generic corpus runner as of the same repair wave (see config-01's expected.json note). Also proven by test/store/config-load.test.ts and test/gates/config.test.ts (the shardsMaxLines-specific cases) plus test/gates/shards.test.ts's 'rk-xbm: a malformed shardsMaxLines never produces a false-green' describe block, which proves the false-green is closed even without this fixture's config gate being wired up.
